name: FilmBee File Sharing Bot
description: File sharing bot to store posts and access them via special links, modified by @EithonX for @Film_Bee.

TG_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Bot token, Get it from @Botfather

OWNER_ID.description: An integer consisting of your owner Telegram User ID.

APP_ID.description: Your app id, take it from my.telegram.org

DATABASE_URL.description: Paste your MongoDB URL (e.g., from MongoDB Atlas).

API_HASH.description: Your api hash, take it from my.telegram.org

CHANNEL_ID.description: Make a channel (database channel), then make the bot an admin in the channel, and put its ID here (e.g., -100xxxxxxxxxx).

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: ID of the channel or group for Force Subscribe. Put 0 to disable.

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL2.description: ID of a second channel or group for Force Subscribe. Put 0 to disable.

ADMINS.description: A space-separated list of User IDs of Admins. They can assist with bot management based on its features (e.g., creating links).

PROTECT_CONTENT.description: Set to 'True' to protect content in the DB channel from being forwarded or saved by users. 'False' to allow.
